name: hud_stack_late_window_press
description: A press in a build window's last moments asks for the second press too (M8, design 5.7 and 2.7: 'a stray key never sends a wave'): offline a READY lands within a turn, so with 2 or 1 ticks of the countdown left it would land after the window's horn, where its READY, naming wave 1, would call nothing (the review), so the press means wave 2. One press of D there sends nothing and asks 'Call wave 2 now? Press again': the window's horn sounds on its own, wave 1 walks alone, and the question lapses after two seconds with nothing called; a second press within them calls wave 2, which sets out at once. With more of the window left one press is the window's Ready, as before (its horn sounds early, nothing more is called). In the window before the last wave, where nothing could be called after it, one press is the window's Ready, and if it lands after the horn its refusal goes unsaid, as a Ready too late for the horn always did, not 'Wave 12 is the last' with the error sound.

steps.msg: two ticks left: a READY sent now may land after the horn

steps.assert: Game.state == 1 and Game.wave == 1 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1]) and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.wants_ready()
steps.msg: the window's horn sounded on its own and the press called nothing

steps.assert: scene.controller.call_armed() and node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'Call wave 2 now? Press again'
steps.msg: the press asked for a second
the second press within two seconds calls wave 2, at once

steps.assert: Game.state == 1 and Game.wave == 1 and not Game.is_ready() and scene.controller.call_armed()
steps.msg: one tick left: the press asks too

steps.assert: Game.wave == 1 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1]) and not scene.controller.call_armed() and not Game.is_ready() and scene.settled()
steps.msg: unanswered, the question lapses: a stray key sent no wave
a third of a second left: a READY lands in time

steps.assert: Game.wave == 1 and scene.sim.hollows[0].countdown_t == 0 and Game.waves_on_road() == PackedInt32Array([1]) and not scene.controller.call_armed() and not Game.is_ready()
steps.msg: one press is the window's Ready: its horn sounded early, nothing more was called

steps.assert: Game.state == 0 and Game.wave == 11 and not Game.late_in_window()
steps.msg: before the last wave nothing could be called after it

steps.assert: Game.state == 1 and Game.wave == 12 and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.call_armed() and scene.settled()
steps.msg: one press, sent: it landed after the horn and was refused
a window's Ready too late for its horn is not said as a refused call
